items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Cannonball did this thing with Riverside Records, introduced Orrin Keepnews to Wes

ctx.x: upright. And I began to get a little bit more loose with it, a little bit more loose with it. And I played with Cal for a long time, maybe a year.

Meantime, while I was working with Cal Tjader, was when Cannonball did this thing with Riverside Records, introduced Orrin Keepnews to Wes, being in Indianapolis. When we were with the Mastersounds, our last recording with Dick Bock, we did a thing with Three Brothers and Five Others. It was Freddie Hubbard and Pookie and Punchy, Joe something on piano and Paul Parker on drums, and the three brothers. They were the five others.

And when we made the album, there was some time left in the studio, so we said, 'Well, let's just play some kind of straight ahead thing.' And Wes stretched out on it, and it turned out to be a tune called "Finger Pickin'." It got more play than the other thing.
